title: Explore shows the whole market, ordered hood, town, market, online, with towns by adjacency

criteria.text: Every locality-scoped surface (Explore, Home, search, unclaimed, report queue) shows one market: the vantage's, the member's home by default
criteria.note: Scoping is by metro (`resolveFeedMetro` falls back to Sacramento, `src/lib/feed/feed-metro.ts`) [V]. No market scope on any surface. Issue #696 is deferred to the fortnight after beta.

criteria.text: Inside the market: hood, town, towns by adjacency, rest of the market, online last; county remainder counts as a town; bridge table
criteria.note: No adjacency table, no `ST_Touches`, no bridge table, no town or hood band in the repo [V grep]. Order today is recency and community response (F059).

criteria.text: No distance, hop count or "near you" shown or filterable anywhere
criteria.note: Distance still shows: `venueDistanceMeters` on `/p/[...slug]`, haversine miles in `MarketSelector.tsx`, "near you" in `HomeFeed.tsx` and layout copy [V]. Only guard: no distance filter in `ExploreFilterSheet.test`.

criteria.text: A Page's market is its anchor Location's, else its owner's home market; a Page in a waiting market is absent until it opens
criteria.note: No Page-to-market link or waiting-market filter in the repo [V grep].

criteria.text: A member with no neighbourhood starts at the town band; the hood band exists and is empty
